Package com.robojacks.lib.hardware

Class BrainScreen

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.hardware.BrainScreen
public final class BrainScreen extends Object
Draws on the brain's touch screen. The drawing area is 480 x 240 pixels, (0, 0) at the top left, colors as 0xRRGGBB. Drawing is slow in Hydrozoa's interpreter, so draw when something changes, not every loop. AutoSelector uses this to show its menu. 

 BrainScreen.clear(BrainScreen.kBlack);
 BrainScreen.print(1, "Battery " + Math.round(RobotController.getBatteryPercent()) + "%");
